title: NoBrew
description: NoBrew is a plugin that lets you remove the ability to brew certain potions.
body:
# **Block specific potions from being brewed**

## Config:
- Choose potion types and levels to block
- Reload supported

## GUI:
- In-game menu to toggle potion types
- Click to enable or disable

## Commands:
- Toggle the system on/off
- Reload the config
